entries.label: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
entries.description: 24/7 support for suicidal crisis or emotional distress (US). Call or text 988.

entries.label: SAMHSA National Helpline
entries.description: Free, confidential, 24/7 treatment referral and information for mental health and substance use (US).

entries.label: National Problem Gambling Helpline
entries.description: 24/7 confidential support for problem gambling (US). Also reachable at 1-800-522-4700.

entries.label: 1-800-QUIT-NOW
entries.description: Free coaching and resources to quit tobacco and nicotine (US).

entries.label: National Alliance for Eating Disorders
entries.description: Referrals and support Mon–Fri 9am–7pm ET (US). For immediate crisis, call or text 988.

entries.label: Samaritans (UK & ROI)
entries.description: 24/7 emotional support. Not US-based — for callers outside the US.

entries.label: Find A Helpline
entries.description: Search verified crisis lines worldwide by country and topic.
